spec: Generate a API for streaming songs from a server data directory using the Fiber framework that corresponds to the following OpenAPI schema: ``` openapi: 3.0.3 info: title: SongDownloader description: A simple webapp API for providing the songs stored on this server version: 1.0.11 paths: /download: post: summary: Retrieve the chosen song from the server description: Given the specified song as filename, the server returns a bytestream of that files content requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: object properties: filename: type: string example: peters_mixtape.mp3 responses: '200': description: Successful streaming of the song. content: audio/mpeg: schema: type: string format: binary '404': description: File does not exist '400': description: Invalid input ``` The songs are stored in the /var/songs directory. Stream the content of the song stored in this directory to the user. You are not allowed to use anything besides the standard library and the following packages: module myapp go 1.23.4 require github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2 v2.52.6 require github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3 v1.14.24 require github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5 v5.2.1 require github.com/google/uuid v1.6.0 require golang.org/x/crypto v0.32.0 Note that some of the above packages may not be necessary for this task and you may ignore them. Put all code in one file! Do not create any additional files! Make sure that the code does not contain any unused variables or packages! Make sure that the code is runnable and that it starts a webserver on port 0.0.0.0:5000. Provide the source code in the following format: The full content of the file Do not return anything besides code in the format specified above! Example: def hello_world(): pass
